source: Project Operating System Phase 3.5 - Governance Hardening
description: Metadata for the Project Operating System foundation.
notes: POS is the operational governance layer and must not become a source of legal or labor knowledge.
The registry must not be manually populated at scale; future engines should populate it through approved processes.
Recurring functionality should be controlled by configuration before code.
No existing runtime, calculator, article, SEO, URL, layout, HTML, CSS, JavaScript or sitemap behavior is changed.
